219|@[simp]
   220|theorem arctan_eq_pi_div_four : arctan x = π / 4 ↔ x = 1 := arctan_injective.eq_iff' arctan_one
   221|
   222|@[simp]
   223|theorem arctan_neg (x : ℝ) : arctan (-x) = -arctan x := by simp [arctan_eq_arcsin, neg_div]
   224|
   225|@[simp]
   226|theorem arctan_eq_neg_pi_div_four : arctan x = -(π / 4) ↔ x = -1 :=
   227|  arctan_injective.eq_iff' <| by rw [arctan_neg, arctan_one]
   228|
   229|@[simp]
   230|theorem arctan_pos : 0 < arctan x ↔ 0 < x := by
   231|  simpa only [arctan_zero] using arctan_lt_arctan_iff (x := 0)
   232|
   233|@[simp]
   234|theorem arctan_lt_zero : arctan x < 0 ↔ x < 0 := by
   235|  simpa only [arctan_zero] using arctan_lt_arctan_iff (y := 0)
   236|
   237|@[simp]
   238|theorem arctan_nonneg : 0 ≤ arctan x ↔ 0 ≤ x := by
   239|  simpa only [arctan_zero] using arctan_le_arctan_iff (x := 0)
   240|
   241|@[simp]
   242|theorem arctan_le_zero : arctan x ≤ 0 ↔ x ≤ 0 := by
   243|  simpa only [arctan_zero] using arctan_le_arctan_iff (y := 0)
   244|
   245|theorem arctan_eq_arccos (h : 0 ≤ x) : arctan x = arccos (√(1 + x ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
   246|  rw [arctan_eq_arcsin, arccos_eq_arcsin]; swap; · exact inv_nonneg.2 (sqrt_nonneg _)
   247|  congr 1
   248|  rw_mod_cast [← sqrt_inv, sq_sqrt, ← one_div, one_sub_div, add_sub_cancel_left, sqrt_div,
   249|    sqrt_sq h]
   250|  all_goals positivity
   251|
   252|-- The junk values for `arccos` and `sqrt` make this true even for `1 < x`.
   253|theorem arccos_eq_arctan (h : 0 < x) : arccos x = arctan (√(1 - x ^ 2) / x) := by
   254|  rw [arccos, eq_comm]
   255|  refine arctan_eq_of_tan_eq ?_ ⟨?_, ?_⟩
   256|  · rw_mod_cast [tan_pi_div_two_sub, tan_arcsin, inv_div]
   257|  · linarith only [arcsin_le_pi_div_two x, pi_pos]
   258|  · linarith only [arcsin_pos.2 h]
   259|
   260|theorem arctan_inv_of_pos (h : 0 < x) : arctan x⁻¹ = π / 2 - arctan x := by
   261|  rw [← arctan_tan (x := _ - _), tan_pi_div_two_sub, tan_arctan]
   262|  · norm_num
   263|    exact (arctan_lt_pi_div_two x).trans (half_lt_self_iff.mpr pi_pos)
   264|  · rw [sub_lt_self_iff, ← arctan_zero]
   265|    exact tanOrderIso.symm.strictMono h
